main_text.l: INTRODVCTIO IN
ARTEM IESVITICAM,
A Gabriele Bariaco Lermeo, Nobili Volca,
Ad venerandos patres Turnoni eam ar-
tem facientes.
LERIQVE non omnino re-
rum imperiti artem hanc
Giesiticam ac eius professo-
res Giesitas appellarunt, ni-
mirum à Giesi, Helisei fa-
mulo, qui donorum spiri-
tualium mercedem à Naa-
mano Syro flagitauit. Quæ etymologia quam-
uis vulgò nonnullis arriserit, à quorum agnatis
Icsuitæ munera forsan aucupati erant, à saniori-
bus tamen reiicitur, ipsa tum scribendi ratione,
tum rerum analogia repugnante. Giesi enim si-
bi appetiit munera, quæ magna animi constan-
tia Helisceus aspernatus erat: at quidquid Icsuitæ
suis artibus hinc inde contrahunt, non tam sibi,
quàm Papæ quærere videntur. Adde quòd
neque Papa Heliseo satis respondet, neque lepram

page.notes: Decorative woodcut initial "D" at the start of the first paragraph, read as the letter D. Printed text "LERIQVE" is as printed for the opening word. "Helisei", "Giesi" and "Icsuitæ" are spelled as printed. The woodcut headpiece is not transcribed. Ornamental elements and the page's faint edge markings were omitted.
